title: Tiny, cute spinning top
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='bodyGrad' cx='40%' cy='35%' r='70%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff8fb3'/>
      <stop offset='55%' stop-color='#e8477a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#a81f4d'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id='spinGrad' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6c2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffcc4d'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- motion swirl at base -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='34' ry='8' fill='#5fd6e8' opacity='0.45'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='22' ry='5' fill='#a6f0fa' opacity='0.55'/>

  <!-- body cone -->
  <path d='M28 62 Q50 84 72 62 L66 44 Q50 50 34 44 Z' fill='url(#bodyGrad)'/>

  <!-- stripe band on body -->
  <path d='M31 54 Q50 68 69 54 L66 47 Q50 60 34 47 Z' fill='#ffd166' opacity='0.9'/>
  <path d='M29 61 Q50 76 71 61 L68 55 Q50 69 32 55 Z' fill='#ffe9a8' opacity='0.75'/>

  <!-- top disc -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='22' ry='8' fill='#ffb3cf'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='22' ry='8' fill='url(#spinGrad)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='40' rx='13' ry='4.5' fill='#ffe9a8' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- handle stem -->
  <rect x='46' y='24' width='8' height='15' rx='4' fill='#7fe0ee'/>
  <rect x='47' y='25' width='3' height='13' rx='1.5' fill='#c8f8ff' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- knob on top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='22' r='6' fill='#ffcc4d'/>
  <circle cx='48.5' cy='20.5' r='2.2' fill='#fff6c2' opacity='0.9'/>

  <!-- spin sparkles -->
  <path d='M20 46 l3 0 l-1.5 -3 z' fill='#a6f0fa'/>
  <path d='M82 50 l2.5 1 l-1.5 2 z' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='16' cy='60' r='1.8' fill='#ff8fb3'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='38' r='1.6' fill='#a6f0fa'/>
</svg>
